# IDIBELL

> IDIBELL (Bellvitge Biomedical Research Institute) is a leading research institution focused on translational medicine, cancer research, neuroscience, and regenerative medicine.

IDIBELL is a biomedical research institute that conducts cutting-edge research across multiple therapeutic areas including oncology, neuroscience, and regenerative medicine. The institute publishes annual reports documenting research activities and achievements across its specialized research groups.
